Appellant/Accused:
 Babu,S/O Karappan,Aged 46 Years Ambalamkunnu Paniya Colony,
 Chulliyode, Nenmeni Amsam, Sulthanbathery, Wayanad District. , Pin -
 673592
Respondent/Complainant:
 State Of Kerala Public Prosecutor, High Court Of Kerala, Ernakulam.

, Pin - 682031
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
High Court be pleased to suspend the conviction and sentence passed
against the Petitioner in S.C.No.320/2016 on the file of the Court of
Additional Sessions Court-I,Kalpetta,Wayanad,Dated 16.06.2017 till the
disposal of the Crl.A.
 This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application
and upon hearing the arguments of V.A.Ajivas, Advocate for the petitioner
and Public Prosecutor for the respondent, the court passed the following:
 C.S.Sudha, J.
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 Crl.M.Appl. No.2 of 2024
 in
 Crl. Appeal No.1914 of 2024
 &
 Crl. Appeal No.1914 of 2024
 ---------------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 08th day of November 2024
 Order
This application under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/accused in S.C.No.320 of 2016 on the file of the Court of Session, Kalpeta.
He has been convicted and sentenced for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(j) and Section 354-B IPC.
He has been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
The maximum period of imprisonment he will have to undergo is ten years.
2. It is brought to my notice that the counsel in this case has been appointed through the Kerala State Legal Services in & Authority (KeL.SA).

1 11/05/2016 and he continues to be so.
